thread:
elaine: kickoff — tabletop incident drill starting now. scenario: simulated api-region us-west-2 degradation causing high 5xx rates for generation endpoints. this is a comms-only drill (no infra changes). I'll play Scribe. @mike and @sana you are on-call; @jason you own customer comms. please follow the comms playbook channels. :drill:
incident-bot: PAGING TEST: simulating pager to @mike and @sana for incident 000-DRILL — severity P1 simulated. see https://intranet/redwood/incidents/drill-000
mike: ack — received simulated page. I'll join bridge in 2m. currently on device; switching to laptop.
sana: ack. I'm online. I'll start triage repro steps against the simulator. tagging @lucy for logs access.
jason: acknowledged. preparing draft status page + customer email for the drill. will post templates in thread for review.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook reminder: follow the 'Comms — Header + Impact + What we know + Next steps' template. Link: /runbooks/comms-template
mike: quick note — simulated error: 503 with payload "kv-cache-miss" in logs. rate spike from a single worker pool. looks like model shard evictions in sim. collecting stack traces now.
sana: capturing the minimal repro and sequence of events. will add a short timeline for status page.
jason: DRAFT status page update (short):
```
Status: Degraded - Generation API in us-west-2
Updated: 2026-03-15T15:03Z
Impact: A subset of requests to the Generation API in us-west-2 are receiving 5xx errors or higher latency. Customers may experience failed responses or timeouts.
What we're doing: Our on-call team is investigating the root cause and applying mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
Next update: 15:18Z
```
please critique tone/clarity.
lucy: looks good. add # of affected customers if you can estimate — even a rough percentage helps. maybe: "affecting up to 8% of requests".
jason: updated: added "affecting up to ~8% of requests". new draft below: 
```
Status: Degraded - Generation API (us-west-2)
Updated: 2026-03-15T15:05Z
Impact: Affecting up to ~8% of generation requests in us-west-2. Some customers may see 5xx errors or long latencies.
What we're doing: Engineers are investigating a worker eviction pattern and performing config rollbacks in the simulator to validate mitigations.
Next update: 15:20Z
```
elaine: good — keep language customer-facing, avoid deep technical jargon in public status. internal comms can have the details.
sana: INTERNAL NOTE for slack/internal: timeline so far — 15:01 simulated spike starts; 15:02 alerts; 15:03 pager fired; 15:04 initial triage, seeing 503s from cache-miss; 15:06 tried a quick config tweak in sim (no change).
mike: draft customer notification (short, email/snippet):
```
Subject: Service degradation in US-West affecting Generation API
Body: Hi — we're investigating an issue impacting a subset of Generation API requests in US-West. You may see intermittent 5xx errors or increased latency. Our team is actively investigating and we'll share updates on the status page. We apologize for the disruption. If you are experiencing critical business impact, reply and we'll prioritize outreach.
```
jason: nice. maybe add a small note about mitigation timeline: "We expect to have a mitigation in place within ~30 minutes; we'll confirm when resolved."
lucy: suggestion — for high-profile customers we should send an SLA-flagged DM template and offer a dedicated channel. add a line: "If this impacts SLA, contact your account rep".
jason: added SLA note into the targeted customer DM template and posted it to the thread: 
```
Customer DM (targeted):
Hi <CustomerName>, we’re currently investigating an issue affecting Generation API in US-West which may cause intermittent errors. We’re prioritizing customers with active SLAs and will provide a dedicated update channel if needed. Can you confirm whether this impacts production workflows?
```
ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: for drills, mark messages as [DRILL] in status page copy to avoid customer confusion.
elaine: good catch — mark the public status page with [DRILL] prefix for this exercise. jason, update please.
jason: updated status page draft with [DRILL] tag: 
```
[DRILL] Status: Degraded - Generation API (us-west-2)
Updated: 2026-03-15T15:08Z
Impact: Affecting up to ~8% of generation requests in us-west-2. Some customers may see 5xx errors or long latencies.
What we're doing: This is a communications drill. On-call team is practicing incident notification, customer messaging, and handoffs. No production changes are being made.
Next update: 15:23Z
```
mike: beginning simulated mitigation step 1: toggle routing fallback to warm pool in simulator. posting command I ran: `rwdctl route-set --region us-west-2 --fallback warm-pool` — no infra impact, sim only.
sana: mitigation observed in sim: error rate dropped from 8% to ~2% after routing fallback. recording that in timeline.
elaine: handoff time approaching — @mike you'll hand off to @sana at +30m in drill. use the handoff template below.
elaine: HANDOFF TEMPLATE (internal):
```
Handoff: Incident 000-DRILL
Outgoing: <name> — summary of actions taken, open actions, next steps, estimates, who to escalate to.
Incoming: <name> — confirm ownership, review timeline, accept or assign tasks.
Outstanding actions: 1) validate mitigation across regions 2) coordinate customer outreach for SLA customers 3) update postmortem checklist
```
mike: Handoff posted. outgoing summary: I toggled routing fallback in sim, saw reduction in error rate to ~2%. left a note to validate warm-pool stability. handing to @sana for validation and customer comms confirmation.
sana: incoming ack. I'll validate across additional simulated tenants and coordinate with @jason on whether to escalate to targeted DMs.
elaine: quick retrospective notes — what went well: quick pager, clear templates, timely status page draft; what to improve: label [DRILL] earlier, clearer customer segmentation for DMs, confirm runbook link visibility for new responders.
jason: action items I'll take: 1) add explicit [DRILL] checkbox in status page editor 2) make an SLA-customer DM template available in console 3) add links to runbook in the pager payload.
lucy: I'll follow up to add a short 'comms checklist' card to the runbook for quick copy/paste snippets.
incident-bot: DRILL COMPLETE: incident 000-DRILL closed at 2026-03-15T15:30Z (simulated). Please file a short post-drill recap in #incidents-postmortems within 24 hours.
elaine: thanks everyone. short ask: drop one-line feedback in this thread about the drill format (timing, bot behavior, templates). I'll compile into a recap doc. :thumbsup:
